Each instance of aes_sel_buf_chk is generated with parameters Sp2VNum, Sp2VWidth, Sp2VEnSecBuf[i] and connected to clk_i, rst_ni, sp2v_sig[i] as sel_i, sp2v_sig_chk_raw[i] as sel_o, and sp2v_sig_err[i] as err_o.

assumptions.claim: Parameters Sp2VNum, Sp2VWidth, and Sp2VEnSecBuf[i] must be legal for the aes_sel_buf_chk instance and consistent with the intended sparse FSM checking configuration.
assumptions.risk: If parameters are inconsistent (e.g., EnSecBuf enabled without proper security buffering constraints), the instance may produce incorrect sel_o timing or miss errors.
